unintendedEffects.effect: A full 394-transaction rehearsal can be broadcast onto a pre-existing, non-genesis anvil chain with every post-condition passing.
clean:local deletes git-tracked files and reaches outside the repository into ~/.foundry; it runs twice, the second time concurrently with the live anvil it is wiping scratch state from.

`dev` never terminates (serve blocks forever), so none of the ~40 in-script assertions can be gated in CI, and Ctrl-C leaves the background anvil alive — creating UE-1's precondition.
unintendedEffects.directConfirmation: Confirmed at teardown of the clean run, not merely reasoned about. After `npm run serve` was killed, `npm run dev` returned EXIT 0 and pipeline A's anvil SURVIVED: `pgrep -af anvil` -> pid 63568 `npm run start:anvil`, 63594/63595 `anvil --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8545 --chain-id 31337 --block-time 2`, and `eth_chainId` on 8545 still answered `0x7a69` (31337). The audit had to kill those PIDs explicitly. That surviving process IS the precondition for UE-1.

entries.basis: The DeployMocks-level fix is exactly what story 079 mandated: vm.envOr("LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU", true) at :398, a full dormant leg at :400/:1631-1639/:2044-2061/:2193-2199, armed-by-default explicitly correct per 079. This delta then added LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU=true to the `dev` key itself, and a command-prefix assignment overrides the inherited environment (verified: `LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU=false bash -c 'LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU=true sh -c "echo $LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU"'` -> true; control -> false). The dormant leg is therefore unreachable through `npm run dev`, contradicting the script's own NatSpec at :210 and the instruction it prints at :1634. Not an incomplete fix as filed; a correct fix undone at the entry-point layer by an untagged commit. Do not flip to fixed until package.json:16 is corrected.
